versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the frontend-design skill, focused on creating distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces.
- Emphasizes bold, intentional design choices and avoids generic AI aesthetics.
- Provides guidelines for typography, color, motion, spatial composition, and visual details.
- Outlines anti-patterns and common pitfalls to avoid.
- Sets clear requirements for production-quality, highly creative output across web technologies.
- Encourages unique, memorable designs with clear aesthetic direction for every project.
